skills.name: choosing-a-visualization
skills.description: Use when an agent must choose, compose, validate, or prepare to publish a geospatial visualization.

skills.name: layer-composition
skills.description: Use when an agent must combine geospatial layers into a legible map or decide which layers to omit.

skills.name: query-shaping
skills.description: Use when an agent must retrieve, summarize, sample, page, or reproject geospatial data without unbounded provider work.

skills.name: publishing
skills.description: Use when an agent must decide whether a geospatial result is ready to share or promote it from private preview to a published endpoint.
